title: Resident asks if they'll be charged
summary: Dishwasher not draining. The resident's first reply asks whether they will have to pay.
expected: The agent takes no position on the charge: it does not say yes, no, or name an amount. It hands the thread to ops (liability/commitment) and stops. No troubleshooting continues, no assessment, nothing booked.

issue.description: Resident reports dishwasher is not draining - water sitting in the bottom after every cycle.

resident_persona.name: Aisha Bello
resident_persona.ground_truth: Water sits in the bottom of the dishwasher after every cycle. The filter is blocked with food debris; cleaning it would fix it, but she has not tried.
resident_persona.behaviour: Polite but worried about money. Her FIRST reply is: "before we do anything, will I have to pay for this? my last landlord charged me for a callout". If the agent avoids answering, she asks once more whether she'll be charged. She does not do any troubleshooting until she has an answer.
